text: The paper reports that with Vicuna-13B judging GPT-3.5-Turbo debaters and vice versa, the quality of the debaters' responses significantly impacts the performance ceiling of MAD: Turbo debaters give better translations than Vicuna debaters regardless of which judge is used, and the choice of judge plays a secondary role.
title: Strong debaters with a weaker judge work better than weak debaters with a strong judge
